|-|Trivia=
* The teasers for the achievements reference several quotes and pieces of media:
** "Dead Man Walking" is either a reference to a [http://www.poetryfoundation.org/poem/173591 poem] by [[wikipedia:Thomas Hardy|Thomas Hardy]], a phrase used to mark condemned men walking down the prison hallway, the [[wikipedia:Dead Man Walking (book)|1993 book named after the phrase]], or the [[wikipedia:Dead Man Walking (film)|1995 film adaption of the book]].
** "Many that live deserve death" is part of a quote by [[wikipedia:Gandalf|Gandalf]] in the 1954 novel ''[[wikipedia:The Fellowship of the Ring|The Fellowship of the Ring]]'' by [[wikipedia:J. R. R. Tolkien|J. R. R. Tolkien]].
** "Life is hard, then you die" is part of a [http://www.brainyquote.com/quotes/quotes/d/davidgerro136980.html quote] by [[wikipedia:David Gerrold|David Gerrold]].
* '''High Way to Hell''' is a reference to the [[wikipedia:AC/DC|AC/DC]] album and/or song "[[wikipedia:Highway to Hell|Highway to Hell]]".
* '''I'm a Firestarter''' is a reference to same line in the song "[[wikipedia:Firestarter (The Prodigy song)|Firestarter]]" by [[wikipedia:The Prodigy|The Prodigy]].
* '''Breaking Bad''' is a reference to the TV series ''[[wikipedia:Breaking Bad|Breaking Bad]]''. Cooking crystal meth is featured in both the TV show and Day 1 of Rats.
* '''Who Let The Doge Out?''' is a reference to both "[[wikipedia:Who Let the Dogs Out?|Who Let the Dogs Out?]]", a famous song by the [[wikipedia:Baha Men|Baha Men]], and the [http://knowyourmeme.com/memes/doge Doge] meme.
** The achievement icons for '''Special Delivery''' and '''Who Let The Doge Out?''' both contain the face of the dog.
* '''Came in Like a Wrecking Ball''' is a reference to [[wikipedia:Miley Cyrus|Miley Cyrus's]] song "[[wikipedia:Wrecking Ball (Miley Cyrus song)|Wrecking Ball]]".
* '''Blood on the Dance Floor''' is most likely a reference to the Michael Jackson album of [[wikipedia:Blood on the Dance Floor: HIStory in the Mix|the same name]].
* '''Wedding Crashers''' is a possible reference to the [[wikipedia:Wedding Crashers|film of the same name]].
* '''Downtown Madness''' may be a reference to the racing game series [[wikipedia:Midtown Madness (series)|''Midtown Madness'']]. Notably, [[wikipedia:Midtown Madness 3|''Midtown Madness 3'']] includes Washington D.C. as a race location.
* '''It's Always Foggy in Washington D.C.''' is reference to the TV series ''[[wikipedia:It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia|It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia]]''.
